The ternary expression (7 * 42) - num > 200 calculates (294 - 106) = 188 > 200, which evaluates to false, causing bar to receive the unsanitized param value. Although user input is retrieved via request headers into the variable param, the switch target is derived from guess.charAt(1) on constant string 'ABC', which always yields 'B'. This deterministically executes case 'B', setting bar to the hardcoded literal 'bob', preventing any tainted input from reaching the exec invocation.
